_comment: Deliberately timid profile for the first time this drives a real Spot arm.
Gains are 0.2, so 90 degrees of leader travel moves a Spot joint 18 degrees:
a sign error shows up as a small wrong-way drift you have time to react to,
rather than as a fast swing. max_joint_vel is a quarter of the normal value,
so nothing can move faster than a slow walk of the joint. The deadband is
wide enough that hand tremor commands nothing at all.
Use it with --only-joint to check one joint's direction at a time:
Once every joint's direction is confirmed, drop --only-joint, then raise the
gains with ] until it feels right, and copy the number you settled on into
your own config. Do not edit this file: its whole value is being timid.
